    cid = res[2];
    pid = 1;

var resp = java.ajax(url);
resp = JSON.parse(resp);
pid = resp.max;
res += resp.html;
if (pid > 1) {
  for (let i = 2; i <= pid; i ++) {
  url = `https://m.23mhx.com/api/chapter_api.php?aid=${aid}&cid=${cid}&pid=${i}&_=1780397771314`
  resp = java.ajax(url);
  resp = JSON.parse(resp);
res += resp.html;
}
}

</js>
